meta.description: Pokémon Connections: sixteen Pokémon, four hidden groups: types, abilities, evolutions, stats and more. Find what links them with four mistakes to spare. A new puzzle every day, an archive and unlimited practice.

info.description: PokéConnections is a free Pokémon Connections puzzle: sort sixteen Pokémon into four hidden groups with four mistakes to spare.
info.intro: PokéConnections is Pokémon Connections: sixteen Pokémon, four hidden groups, and a new puzzle every day.
info.step1: Look at the sixteen Pokémon and find the ones that share something: a type, an ability, an evolution, stats and more.
info.step2: Select four and submit them as a group.
info.step3: You can make four mistakes before the puzzle ends.
info.step4: Play the daily puzzle, browse the archive or practice without limit.
